<?php
class Owner {
 public static function ok() {}
 public function test() {
  $method='missing'; $cb=['self', &$method];
  set_error_handler(function($level,$message) use (&$method) { echo $message,":",$method,"|"; $method='ok'; return true; });
  $take=function(callable $c) { echo "admitted:"; echo $c[1]; };
  $take($cb); restore_error_handler();
 }
}
(new Owner)->test();

<?php
class Other {}
class Owner {
 public static function handle($n,$s,$f,$l) { echo "Owner-handler"; return true; }
 public function test() {
  $class='self'; $cb=[&$class,'handle'];
  set_error_handler(function($n,$s) use (&$class) { echo "deprecation|"; $class='Other'; return true; });
  set_error_handler($cb); echo "registered:",$class,"|";
  try { echo $missing; } catch (Throwable $e) { echo $e->getMessage(); }
 }
}
(new Owner)->test();

$count = 0;
$method = 'parent::xx';
function warn($n, $s, $f, $l) {
    global $count, $method;
    echo $s, "|";
    $count++;
    if ($count === 1) { $method = 'parent::ok'; }
    else { $method = 'YYYYYY::ok'; }
    return true;
}
class Base { public static function ok() {} }
class Child extends Base {
    public static function receive(callable $cb) { echo "admitted:", $cb[1]; }
}
set_error_handler('warn');
$cb = ['self', &$method];
Child::receive($cb);

<?php
$free = 'self::xx';
function warn($n, $s, $f, $l) {
    global $free;
    echo "deprecation|";
    A::$cb = '12345678';
    $free = '12345678';
    return true;
}
class A {
    public static string $cb = 'self::xx';
    public static function receive(callable|int &$value) {
        echo ($value === 12345678 ? 'free-int|' : 'wrong-value|');
    }
}
set_error_handler('warn');
try { A::receive(A::$cb); }
catch (TypeError $e) { echo (A::$cb === '12345678' ? 'typed-string|' : 'wrong-typed|'); }
$free = 'self::xx';
A::receive($free);
echo ($free === 12345678 ? 'caller-int' : 'wrong-caller');

 public static function run($n,$s,$f,$l) { echo func_num_args(),':',self::class,':',static::class,'|'; return true; }
}
class Middle extends Base {
 public function test() {
  error_reporting(0);
  foreach ([['parent','run'],['static','run'],'parent::run','static::run'] as $cb) {
   set_error_handler('warn'); set_error_handler($cb); echo $missing;
   restore_error_handler(); restore_error_handler();
  }
 }
}
